comments.body: Looks like this is caused by a bad export of a rotary positional embedding layer. Closing as the issue is not a codegen problem.


The compiler error does not reproduce with pip installed IREE compiler, but encounters a semaphore abort when the module is executed with iree-run-module. IREE was built from source in debug mode at top of main (e5b65b533fec33c94e5cc7a5079b1c51131d46a7) to find this error about shape/layout mismatch on the attention op.

### Steps to reproduce your issue

1. Create wan_dispatch_26.mlir and paste in the IR provided at top of this issue.
2. Build latest top of IREE main (iree-org/iree@e5b65b533fec33c94e5cc7a5079b1c51131d46a7 when issue was encountered) in debug mode
3. Run compile command.

### What component(s) does this issue relate to?

Compiler

### Version information

e5b65b533fec33c94e5cc7a5079b1c51131d46a7 (debug build)

### Additional context

The error is the same for --iree-opt-level O0 - O3 for this dispatch.
issue.title: [codegen] Wan2.1 transformer attention shape/layout mismatch for MFMA intrinsics

timeline.body: Looks like this is caused by a bad export of a rotary positional embedding layer. Closing as the issue is not a codegen problem.
